text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Some 20,000 soldiers to handle security during the Pope's visit to Lebanon next Saturday.
- Prime Minister Hariri inspects work at an open air chapel built especially for Sunday's mass, celebrated by the pope near Beirut's central district.
- Iran's Foreign Minister Velayati in Beirut today.
- Solidere shares reach record highs locally and internationally.
- Israeli shelling of Iqlim al-Toufah, the eastern and the central sectors of south Lebanon. Two South Lebanon Army militiamen wounded in a roadside bomb near Burj al-Mulouk.
- The weekly issue of treasury bills raises 585.8 billion pounds.
- Prime Minister Bouez to Romania on May 14.
- ESCWA holds conference in Beirut ahead of moving regional offices to Lebanon.
- Former Lebanese army commander in exile General Aoun urges Lebanese people to warmly welcome the Pope.
